subject: MPA tactical reset: proposed go-live cushion and credit bridge
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medalign.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rpatel@medalign.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Project cadence pressure — close date slipping

Maya —

Quick note from our side after the steering meeting this morning. We remain committed to Redwood, but internal procurement and our security team have flagged two items that will push our acceptance window out if we don't resolve them:

1) SOC2 evidence items (one outstanding control evidence packet) — security wants a final artifact by next Tuesday.
2) Legal wants a clarified SLA & credit position for the final 30 days of our go-live window.

Right now the program team is predicting a 2–3 week slip to the go-live target unless we can show a concrete mitigation (either pushback cushion in the MAP or a limited credit/holdback to cover the risk).

Can we schedule a 30–45 minute working session this afternoon to update the MAP and capture an agreed cushion and acceptance gating? If Redwood can propose a short-term credit structure (not full discount) tied to missed milestones, that will give our CFO comfort and keep momentum.

Attachments: none on this note (I can share internal notes after the call).

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Program Director, MedAlign Health
---
Alyssa Chen
Alyssa.chen@medalign.com
(415) 555-0127

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medalign.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rpatel@medalign.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Project cadence pressure — close date slipping

Thanks for the clear note, Alyssa. We can absolutely get ahead of this and propose a pragmatic path. Proposed immediate steps: 

- 30-minute working session today at 3:00pm PT (confirmed on my calendar).
- I'll bring a revised MAP spreadsheet (MAP_v2.xlsx) that builds a 10-business-day cushion and calls out the SOC2 artifact delivery path.
- Jonas will propose a short-term SLA addendum with a capped credit for missed acceptance windows (not to exceed 5% of monthly committed usage) so the CFO has a concrete number to evaluate.

Summary of what we'll cover in the call:
- Exact SOC2 evidence items outstanding and ownership for delivery
- Proposed go-live cushion (10 business days) + parallel validation window
- Draft credit/escrow structure and trigger language
- A clear mutual checklist and owners in the MAP so acceptance gating is deterministic

I'll attach the MAP_v2.xlsx after the call with cells flagged for your review. If the working session time doesn't work, suggest alternate slots and we'll flex.

Attachment stub: MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet) — draft cushion and owners

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0133

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medalign.com>, Rajiv Patel <rpatel@medalign.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: SLA addendum proposal + escalation note

Folks —

Following the working session yesterday (thanks, Maya), I put together the short SLA addendum note and escalation language for the MAP. Key points: 

- Proposal: If final acceptance is missed by more than 5 business days beyond the agreed acceptance date, Redwood will issue a one-time credit equal to 3% of the first month committed spend. If missed by more than 15 business days, credit increases to 7% and we will enable a priority remediation lane. Credits are capped in the proposal to avoid open-ended liability.
- Rationale: gives MedAlign immediate financial assurance without full discounting and aligns incentives for both teams to prioritize artifact delivery.
- Operational: Camila will own SOC2 artifact validation support (SLA response within 48 hours of evidence upload).

I've attached a short explainer as an internal stub (SLA_escrow_note.pdf) for legal to review; the doc will be uploaded to the HubSpot link for tracking.

Next actions (owner / ETA):
- Camila: confirm validation process and expected turnaround (ETA: EOD 2026-06-21)
- Maya: circulate final MAP_v2.xlsx with owner cells locked for acceptance (ETA: 2026-06-21T11:00PT)
- Laura: brief sales leadership and confirm that the proposed credit range is within escalation approval (ETA: 2026-06-21T16:00PT)

I'll remain on standby to join any legal/finance calls if needed. Goal is to avoid a formal exec escalation and keep the close within the quarter.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medalign.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rpatel@medalign.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Project cadence pressure — close date slipping

Maya / Jonas —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and concrete numbers. After internal alignment with procurement and finance, MedAlign can accept the proposed approach with one ask: move the cushion to 12 business days (they prefer even-numbered buffer) and include a single clause that allows us to request a one-time priority remediation if evidence slips beyond 10 business days.

We reviewed the MAP_v2.xlsx during our internal sync and confirmed owner assignments. Our security team will upload the remaining control artifact by Monday (2026-06-28) and Camila's 48-hour validation SLA is acceptable.

Please confirm the updated language (12-business-day cushion + remediation request trigger at 10 days) and I'll route the redlined SLA addendum to legal for signoff. If we get signed prior to 2026-07-02, we should keep the original quarter close target; otherwise expect a shift of two weeks.

Attachment stubs: internal redline of MAP_v2.xlsx pending (Alyssa_internal_notes.docx)

Thanks again — Alyssa
